subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff & weekly checkpoint cadence — Paxion Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wallace <emma@paxionhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@paxionhealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff & weekly checkpoint cadence — Paxion Health

Hi Emma / Liam,

Great to meet you both on the call yesterday. As discussed, I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) kickoff to align on stakeholders, cadence, success criteria for evaluation, and a clear close timeline to get Paxion into a dedicated evaluation by mid-May.

Quick summary of proposed items for next steps:
- Weekly 30-min checkpoints (progress, blockers, demo notes, decisions)
- Primary contacts: Emma (Paxion PM), Liam (Infra lead), Ben (Redwood AE)
- Success criteria draft: throughput baseline, latency SLO, integration checklist, evaluation quality metrics (see attached doc)
- Target close: commitment decision week of 2026-05-18; internal approvals and procurement TBD

I attached a one-page MAP template (Paxion_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the evaluation criteria doc for your review.

Proposed weekly checkpoint: Thursdays 10:00–10:30am PT starting 2026-04-15. Please let me know if that works or propose an alternative. Also flag any other stakeholders to include (security, procurement, engineering).

Deliverables for first checkpoint (04/15):
1) Shared MAP with owners assigned
2) Baseline performance target (tokens/sec, p95 latency)
3) List of integrations needed for test harness (S3 buckets, API keys)

If this looks good I’ll send a calendar invite and a lightweight agenda.

Thanks,
Ben

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Paxion_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP template), Evaluation_Criteria.pdf (pass/fail metrics)
From: Emma Wallace <emma@paxionhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@paxionhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff & weekly checkpoint cadence — Paxion Health

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the note and the docs. The MAP template looks sensible. Thursday 10:00am PT should work for our core team; can we do weekly for the next 6 weeks and then switch to biweekly if things are stable?

A couple of quick clarifications before we lock cadence:
- On success criteria: would you recommend a minimum token/sec target or should we start from latency/quality only?
- Integration: our security team will need the evaluation criteria PDF and a short list of what evidence Redwood can provide (SOC2, data handling, ingress/egress controls). Liam, can you add anyone from Security to the thread if needed.

I’ll confirm the attendees from our side by Monday. Attaching our internal risk summary (Paxion_Risk_Profile.pdf) so you have context.

Cheers,
Emma

—
Emma Wallace
Head of Product
Paxion Health
emma@paxionhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4402

Attachment: Paxion_Risk_Profile.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Wallace <emma@paxionhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@paxionhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan kickoff & weekly checkpoint cadence — Paxion Health

Team —

Forwarding Paxion notes. Action items for us before 04/15:
- Stephanie: update the MAP spreadsheet with our suggested owners and populate the evaluation column (see Evaluation_Criteria.pdf). Aim to share by EOD Mon (04/13).
- Vivek: prepare a short bullet list of evidence we can share with their security team (SOC2 scope, retention, encryption, access controls). If you have a one-pager link, drop it into the Drive folder.
- Marissa: pricing sensitivity — what level of committed throughput discount should we offer for a dedicated POC vs hosted evaluation? Need a ballpark to include in MAP.

I’ll draft the calendar invite and agenda (30 mins) and include the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Paxion/MAP-drafts. Please keep comments inline in the MAP sheet rather than email.

Note on success criteria — recommended approach: start with clear pass/fail gates for integration (API auth + data flow), then measurable performance targets: p95 latency < 300ms, stable throughput to handle 10 req/sec with burst to 30 req/sec (for eval harness). Quality check: human-eval pass rate > 85% on the acceptance prompt set. We can adjust once Paxion provides their baseline.

Ben

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: Paxion_MAP_v1.xlsx, Evaluation_Criteria.pdf

Subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan kickoff & weekly checkpoint cadence — Paxion Health

Hi Emma / Liam —

Thanks for confirming availability. Per our internal prep we’ve updated the MAP and pulled the evaluation criteria into a single packet. Calendar invite sent for Thursdays 10:00–10:30am PT starting 2026-04-15 (recurring weekly).

What we agreed and what will be on the agenda for 04/15:
1) Confirm MAP owners (attached) — owners column populated for each action
2) Integration checklist and next steps for security evidence (Vivek will share a one-pager in the Drive)
3) Baseline targets and test harness requirements (we'll capture Paxion baselines and finalize pass/fail gates)
4) Procurement & timeline: target decision week of 2026-05-18; milestones and procurement contacts to be added next week

Attachments: Paxion_MAP_v1.xlsx, Evaluation_Criteria.pdf (final drafts). Please review the owners column and add any corrections before the meeting.

If you want to add procurement or security now, please invite them to tomorrow’s kickoff — otherwise we’ll capture their contact points and loop them in week 2.

Looking forward to a good kickoff — see you Thursday.

Best,
Ben

—
